title: Categories search shows the Default category first only when it matches
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • The Default category {Default-category-A} (for example Uncategorized) shows the Default badge in the Categories list.
  • Search term {Term-A} (for example categ) is part of the Default category's name.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example AAA-ZZAUTOTEST-PCA02 categ) exists. Its name contains {Term-A} and comes before the Default category's name.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA02 categ) exists. Its name contains {Term-A} and comes after the Default category's name.
  • Search term {Term-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA02) matches {Category-A} and {Category-B} but not the Default category.
  • You are on a page other than Categories and the Categories Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Type {Term-A} in the Search box.
  3. Wait until the list stops changing.
  4. Read the first row and find {Category-A} and {Category-B}.
  5. Click the Name column header.
  6. Read the first row and find {Category-B}.
  7. Clear the Search box.
  8. Type {Term-B} in the Search box.
  9. Wait until the list stops changing.
  10. Read every row shown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the first row is {Default-category-A} with its Default badge. {Category-A} and {Category-B} are below it.
  • Step 6: the first row is still {Default-category-A} with its Default badge, and {Category-B} is below it.
  • Step 10: only {Category-B} and {Category-A} are shown, in that order (Z to A). The Default category is not shown, because its name does not contain {Term-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R19 (search part), §5 Terminology 'Default category', read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 1.2 (Categories - after) and 2.1 (The three rules that bite), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment: Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 882311473), third comment item 2: 'first whenever it is in the list'. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R19: “The Default category is always the first row in the list. It holds that position under the Name sort and under the QuickBooks Products and Services sort, in ascending and in descending order alike, and it holds it after a reload in place. When a search term is typed it is first whenever it is among the matching rows; a term that does not match its name leaves it out of the results, as today, and it is never forced into them. This is the behavior the Categories list has in production today and it does not change.”
  • S1-R18: “Typing a search term keeps the sort. The rows that match the term are shown in the order the current sort produces.”
  • PRD §5 Terminology: “Default category - the category row named "Uncategorized", which carries the "Default" badge and cannot be edited.”
